The bowl is a stainless steel mixing bowl, probably about 25-30 cm across at the rim. The shredded carrot sits in a small pile roughly 12 cm by 10 cm and looks about 2-3 cm deep.

Estimated volume is about 150-250 mL. Loosely packed shredded carrot weighs about 0.3-0.4 g/mL, which gives roughly 60-80 g.

Carrot has about 41 kcal per 100 g, so 70 g is about 29 kcal. The carrot looks slightly glossy, so I allowed a little for oil or dressing and rounded up to about 35 kcal.
